intro: Belarus is a flat, landlocked country of forests, lakes and marshes.

chapters.title: Forests and marshes
text: Forests cover about 40% of the land, and there are thousands of lakes. The Pripyat Marshes in the south are among Europe's largest wetlands. The Białowieża Forest, shared with Poland, is home to European bison.
Belarus borders Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Lithuania and Latvia.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Winters are cold and snowy and summers warm. The highest point is a gentle hill of just over 340 m.

keyTerms.meaning: Wet, low land often covered with water.
